lines.t:
A product number assigned to identify the {{type}} of a
<c:ffff00>{{part}}<c> when it is made. It is assigned based on the
design concept and development version.

As a rule, {{part|pl}} are developed and designed
together for all 4 <c:ffff00>slots<c>, so there is one {{part}} with the
same {{model_number}} for each {{slot}}. A <c:ffff00>{{medabot}}<c> with
the full set of those 4 {{part|pl}} of the same model is
called <c:ffff00>{{original|cap}}<c>.
